## Install — no GitHub CLI, no tokens, no SSH keys

Download the **Source code (zip)** below, extract, and run the bundled installer. Same flow on every OS.

**macOS / Linux**
```bash
cd jtr-1.0.0
./install.sh
```

**Windows**
```powershell
cd .\jtr-1.0.0\
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

The installer fetches `uv` if needed, then runs `uv tool install` on the extracted source. See [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/BD-AI-SDLC/jtr/blob/main/INSTALL.md) for manual steps and troubleshooting.

## jtr 1.0

The CLI surface that has been stable since 0.10.0 — init, both auth families (Server/DC SSO and PAT, Cloud email + API token), search with dialect-correct paging, view, comment, edit, label, assign, transition, all with `--json` — is now the 1.0 contract. Existing setups keep working unchanged; nothing in the CLI or its JSON output changed in this release.

## What's new

**A worca-cc plugin ships in the repo.** `worca-jira-source/` is a source connector for [worca-cc](https://github.com/anthropics/worca)'s New Pipeline that pulls Jira tickets through the `jtr` CLI — jtr owns everything Jira-specific (auth, instance config, REST dialect) and the connector only shells out to `jtr … --json`. Setup runs entirely from the plugin's settings pane: paste any ticket URL, press Connect. It supports both deployments, multiple profiles (several Jira instances per install, each with its own jtr config dir and session), per-run write-back of pipeline results as ticket comments, and an optional workflow transition on successful completion. See [worca-jira-source/README.md](https://github.com/BD-AI-SDLC/jtr/blob/main/worca-jira-source/README.md) for the full tour. It requires jtr ≥ 0.10.0 and is a plugin to link into worca, not part of the installed CLI.

**The Windows installer now fixes PATH.** `install.ps1` adds uv's tool bin dir (`%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin`, or `UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR`) to the user PATH when it's missing — previously, if `uv` had been preinstalled by winget or pip, that directory might never have been on PATH and `jtr` came out unreachable after a successful install. The current session is patched too, and already-open terminals are told they need a restart.

## Upgrading

Install as usual. No config, cookie, or `.env` change is required.
